column1: # PocketMe CYD flash layout (4 MB). Pass it on every flash:
# nvs and phy_init are exactly espflash's default ones: the saved gamepad
# pairing lives in the first 8 KB of nvs and must never move. Only the
# app partition ends earlier (0x3F0000 instead of 0x400000)
# the last 8 KB of the chip to "settings" (console settings
# subtype ESP-IDF keeps for the user: no ESP-IDF part uses it.
